title: Basic material
author: DeepBuild
description: The library's MeshBasicMaterial: its Color, sRGB to our linear base color, drawn as written whatever lights it (material@1 with unlit). A geometry instance wears it by naming `<instance>.material` in its `material`.

color.about: Color as 0xRRGGBB, sRGB; linear in ours

fog.about: true only: the sky's fog reaches every surface

refuses.map: Write the picture on material@1 itself, by its hash, as `maps.base_color`.
refuses.lightMap: Leave it out: material@1 takes no baked light of its own.
refuses.lightMapIntensity: Leave it out: material@1 takes no baked light of its own.
refuses.aoMap: Leave it out: an unlit part takes no ambient light for a picture to shade.
refuses.aoMapIntensity: Leave it out: an unlit part takes no ambient light for a picture to shade.
refuses.specularMap: Leave it out: an unlit part reflects nothing.
refuses.alphaMap: Write the picture on material@1 itself: the alpha of `maps.base_color`, under `alpha_mode`.
refuses.envMap: Leave it out: an unlit part reflects nothing.
refuses.envMapRotation: Leave it out: an unlit part reflects nothing.
refuses.combine: Leave it out: an unlit part reflects nothing.
refuses.reflectivity: Leave it out: an unlit part reflects nothing.
refuses.refractionRatio: Leave it out: an unlit part reflects nothing.
refuses.wireframe: Leave it out: how a surface is rasterized is the renderer's; for its edges alone, draw mark.line@1 items.
refuses.wireframeLinewidth: Leave it out: how a surface is rasterized is the renderer's; for its edges alone, draw mark.line@1 items.
refuses.wireframeLinecap: Leave it out: how a surface is rasterized is the renderer's; for its edges alone, draw mark.line@1 items.
refuses.wireframeLinejoin: Leave it out: how a surface is rasterized is the renderer's; for its edges alone, draw mark.line@1 items.
